subject: AlturaMed: Clarify session/log TTL and SOC 2 / SIG evidence for 18-month carveout
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@alturamed.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question on session/log TTL and SOC 2 / SIG artifacts for 18-month ask

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the performance profile. As we start to draft our procurement packet, Compliance has a couple of follow-ups around data retention for conversational session traces and debug logs. Our requirement is a customer-specific carveout for 18 months for certain diagnostic traces tied to clinical workflows.

Can Redwood provide the SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ artifacts or a tailored evidence bundle that shows:
- How session traces are retained and deleted in hosted vs dedicated deployments (policy + example proof of delete)
- Technical artifacts we can include in our audit: sample retention policy entries, proof-of-delete runbook, S3 lifecycle config snippets, and one sanitized sample deletion log
- Whether you support a customer-scoped retention override (we'd accept a contractual amendment if needed) and the operational steps to request it

I attached our SIG questionnaire (partial). We need to include convincing evidence in our RFP by EOD next Tuesday. Can you confirm what you can deliver and an estimated timeline?

Appreciate it —
Sarah
Sarah Lin
Sr. Compliance Manager, AlturaMed
--- Attachment: alturamed_SIG_questionnaire_v1.pdf (1 page PDF, redacted)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@alturamed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on session/log TTL and SOC 2 / SIG artifacts for 18-month ask

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Kimberly from Security and Ben on the commercial side so we can align technical evidence with contract language.

At a high level: Redwood supports per-tenant retention adjustments in Dedicated and Private deployments today; for Hosted (our multi-tenant public API) we offer limited customer-scoped retention controls (KV/prefix level) and can propose a contractual exception with operational controls for longer retention.

Kimberly — can you confirm the specific artifacts we can produce for an external audit (SOC 2 / SIG) that demonstrate: retained object lifecycle, proof-of-delete, and sanitized deletion logs? Sarah, once we have an artifact list we can map to the SIG questions you provided and produce a zip of samples.

Ben — if we need an 18-month contractual amendment, let me know what language you prefer and whether we should route as an annex vs. an SLA addendum.

Plan: Kimberly to respond with artifact list + ETA. I can coordinate packaging and a short cover letter that ties artifacts to SIG controls.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@alturamed.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on session/log TTL and SOC 2 / SIG artifacts for 18-month ask

Hi all — quick summary of what Redwood can provide and constraints to call out. Attaching a short evidence summary and a sample artifacts bundle.

Artifacts we can produce within 3 business days (package attached):
- Retention policy excerpt (redacted): shows default TTLs for session traces, debug logs, and audit logs across Hosted/Dedicated/Private
- Sample lifecycle config (S3 lifecycle rule snippet) used by our retention automation
- Proof-of-delete sample: timestamped job run output + corresponding storage API delete response (sanitized)
- Deletion audit record: our internal deletion audit entry (sanitized tenant id, hash of object, operator id)
- SOC 2 control mapping doc: how the above artifacts map to CC6/CC8 (data retention & disposition)
- Operational runbook excerpt: steps to request a customer-scoped retention exception and the review/approval gates

Limitations / notes:
- For Hosted customers we do not allow arbitrary per-tenant retention configuration by self-service; we require a legal amendment plus an operational onboarding step (to ensure segregation/compensating controls).
- Proof-of-delete artifacts are sample-based and will be sanitized; we cannot ship raw production identifiers.
- For Private deployments (on-prem/VPC) we can enable customer-controlled retention but need explicit customer acceptance of responsibilities in the deployment annex.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Sarah confirms whether AlturaMed prefers Hosted with exception or Dedicated/Private.
2) If Hosted+exception: Ben and Marissa coordinate on a short annex that defines 18-month retention for the named artifact classes and the compensating controls (encryption, access review cadence).
3) We deliver the evidence bundle and a one-page cover letter mapping artifacts to SIG controls.

I've attached: rwinf-retention-evidence-summary.pdf and retention-evidence-samples.zip (contains the sample artifacts). ETA: 3 business days once you confirm scope.

Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
--- Attachment: rwinf-retention-evidence-summary.pdf (4 pages)
--- Attachment: retention-evidence-samples.zip (5 files: lifecycle.json, delete-job.log, sanitized-deletion-audit.csv, s3-lifecycle-snippet.txt, soc2-mapping.md)

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@alturamed.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Jul 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on session/log TTL and SOC 2 / SIG artifacts for 18-month ask

Kimberly — thank you, this is exactly the direction we needed. The sample artifacts and the mapping doc look good on first pass. Couple of clarifying items from Compliance: 

1) For the Hosted-with-exception path, we need the annex to explicitly state the classes of retained data ("diagnostic session traces associated with clinical workflow IDs"), the exact operational owner at Redwood, and a rollback/remediation timeline in case of accidental exposure.
2) Can you provide an example sanitized deletion audit record with a pseudonymized tenant id (we need to show the chain from delete job -> storage API -> audit entry)?

If you can get the annex language and a sanitized audit row to us by EOD Tuesday (30 Jul) we can include the bundle in our RFP. I've started the DocuSign envelope for the NDA/incorporation of the annex — link below.

DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-ALT-1043

We prefer Hosted+exception for operational simplicity but will consider Dedicated if the annex impacts pricing significantly.

Thanks all — will await the sanitized audit row and the proposed annex text.

Regards,
Sarah
Sr. Compliance Manager, AlturaMed
